capabilities: Manage points of interest in notes
Visualize GPX and GeoJSON data on maps
Query vault notes as map data
extras: Map rendering requires at least one provider extension plugin (e.g. places-leaflet, places-mapbox); search, directions, isochrones, elevation, snap, and track match depend on which providers are installed. A sandbox demo is referenced.
problem: Obsidian has no native way to visualize geographic data such as points of interest, GPX tracks, or GeoJSON on interactive maps.

relations.evidence: SQL queries over vault notes as a map data source
Dataview queries as a map data source

requires.name: a map provider extension (e.g. places-leaflet, places-mapbox)

summary: Map plugin that manages points of interest and GPX/GeoJSON data in notes and visualizes them on interactive maps with markers, tracks, and overlays.
